memo.summary: Context-only committee read: measured market conditions remain risk-on and calm, but the confirmed US Q2/Reflation label is weakly supported and currently disagrees with its own raw axes, which read Q3 after 2 of 7 required confirmation sessions. Breadth and credit remain healthy, volatility is normalizing, and the risk radar's measured 21-day pullback rate is below its base rate, so the evidence does not support originating or escalating a defensive claim. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly, non-stress-confirmed drain. Factor intelligence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G ledger, no factor-attention history, and no tradeable composite. This memo changes no ranking, sizing, signal, or trade surface.

memo.contradictions_review: Two current graph contradictions were reviewed. The broad briefing-divergence tension spans 34 names and deserves persistence testing rather than interpretation as a signal. The options contradiction is limited to KDP with rising five-day OTM-put skew; prior evidence says bullish skew deceleration is unsupported, so this is de-escalation context only. Pair G factor contradictions are absent because the factor panel has not reached its 60-date activation floor. Among open master-brain theses, the July 9 China-equities overweight thesis conflicts with current China/HK regime context. Semiconductor-underweight theses are not contradicted by the current thematic deterioration and broken semiconductor leadership context. Several theses are past their check-by dates but remain open, which weakens ledger hygiene and should be resolved by the authorized scorer.
